name: Sample: parts of a cell
notes:
Parts of a cell
Mitochondria turn food into energy (ATP): they're the powerhouse of the cell.
The Golgi apparatus packages proteins and ships them where they're needed.
Chloroplasts use sunlight to make food for plant cells (photosynthesis).
The vacuole stores water and nutrients; plant cells have one big one.
Ribosomes build proteins.
The nucleus is the control center of the cell: it holds the DNA.
Lysosomes break down waste and worn-out parts with digestive enzymes.
Plant cells have a stiff cell wall for support and protection.
The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
The smooth ER makes lipids (fats) and breaks down toxins.

stops.label: foosball table
stops.fact: Mitochondria turn food into energy (ATP): they're the powerhouse of the cell.
stops.scene: MIGHTY foosball players munch sandwiches and spin so hard the table becomes a POWERHOUSE, popping out glowing ATP batteries.
stops.hook: mitochondria → mighty foosball players · food into energy → sandwiches in, batteries out
stops.imagePrompt: Muscular little foosball players eating sandwiches and spinning on their rods, glowing batteries popping out of the foosball table

stops.label: putting green
stops.fact: The Golgi apparatus packages proteins and ships them where they're needed.
stops.scene: On the putting green, a GOLFer gift-wraps protein bars and putts each box into the right hole to ship it.
stops.hook: Golgi apparatus → the golfer · packages and ships proteins → wrapped boxes putted into holes
stops.imagePrompt: A cheerful golfer on a putting green gift-wrapping boxes and putting them toward flagged holes

stops.label: big windows
stops.fact: Chloroplasts use sunlight to make food for plant cells (photosynthesis).
stops.scene: Green leaves in sunglasses lounge by the big windows like it's a CHLORINE pool, soaking up sunlight and cooking sugar snacks.
stops.hook: chloroplasts → chlorine-pool loungers · photosynthesis → leaves turning sunlight into food
stops.imagePrompt: Green leaf characters in sunglasses lounging in chairs beside a pool, sunbeams shining on them as they cook sugar cubes

stops.label: rental locker
stops.fact: The vacuole stores water and nutrients; plant cells have one big one.
stops.scene: The rent-anything locker is a giant VACUUM-sealed tank of water and snacks. In a plant it's so big it fills the whole wall.
stops.hook: vacuole → vacuum-sealed locker · stores water and nutrients → water and snacks · one big one in plants
stops.imagePrompt: A tall locker kiosk bulging open with a giant sealed water tank full of snacks, a small plant sitting on top

stops.label: chess set
stops.scene: Tiny builders in RIBBONS snap the chess pieces together into one long chain, then hand you a PROTEIN bar made of it.
stops.hook: ribosomes → builders in ribbons · build proteins → a chain of pieces becomes a protein bar
stops.imagePrompt: Tiny builders wearing ribbon bows snapping giant chess pieces into a long chain on a chessboard

stops.label: tv screen
stops.fact: The nucleus is the control center of the cell: it holds the DNA.
stops.scene: BREAKING NEWS on the TV: "NEW CLUES!" The anchor reads orders off a twisting DNA ladder, and every game in the room obeys.
stops.hook: nucleus → "new clues" news · DNA → the twisted-ladder script · control center → everyone obeys the TV
stops.imagePrompt: A TV showing a news anchor pointing at a twisting DNA ladder, little characters in front of it saluting

stops.label: recycling bins
stops.fact: Lysosomes break down waste and worn-out parts with digestive enzymes.
stops.scene: The recycling bins are full of LYSOL-like digestive juice: toss in old trash and broken parts, and they fizz away to nothing.
stops.hook: lysosomes → Lysol bins · digestive enzymes → the fizzing juice · waste and worn-out parts → old trash
stops.imagePrompt: Two blue recycling bins full of bubbling green liquid, a banana peel and a broken gear dissolving as they fall in

stops.label: pillar
stops.fact: Plant cells have a stiff cell wall for support and protection.
stops.scene: A potted PLANT hugs the thick pillar, which is a stiff WALL of armor holding up the whole room. You knock: rock hard.
stops.hook: cell wall → the stiff pillar · plant cells → the potted plant hugging it · support → holding up the room
stops.imagePrompt: A potted plant hugging a thick armored pillar that holds up the ceiling, a fist knocking on the pillar

stops.label: theater doors
stops.fact: The cell membrane controls what enters and leaves the cell.
stops.scene: The theater doors are a MEMBERS-ONLY bouncer: they swing open for water and snacks, then slam shut on a pizza that's way too big.
stops.hook: cell membrane → members-only doors · controls what enters and leaves → the bouncer
stops.imagePrompt: Glass doors with a grumpy bouncer face and a velvet rope, letting a water bottle in while blocking a giant pizza

stops.label: lounge chairs
stops.fact: The smooth ER makes lipids (fats) and breaks down toxins.
stops.scene: The lounge chairs are SMOOTH and slick with BUTTER. You slide right off the end, and a mop scrubs away a puddle of green poison.
stops.hook: smooth ER → the buttery smooth chairs · lipids → butter (fats) · breaks down toxins → mopping up poison
stops.imagePrompt: A kid sliding off a shiny buttered lounge chair, a mop scrubbing away a bubbling green poison puddle
